slides.title: THE STEPS
lines: 2. Square each distance from the mean
slides.note: Standard deviation measures the typical distance of values from the mean.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
slides.problem: Find the sample standard deviation of 2, 4, 6.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: Which has the larger spread: 5, 5, 5 or 1, 5, 9?
steps: 5, 5, 5 has every value at the mean, so s = 0
1, 5, 9 has values far from the mean 5

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: Dividing by n for a sample
points: For a sample, divide by n − 1. For a whole population, divide by n.
Standard deviation is never negative, and it uses the same units as the data.
